description: This file defines the Request class and related classes for handling HTTP and JSON-RPC requests within the Thunder PluginHost namespace. It includes request state management, performance tracking, and JSON-RPC message handling.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP or JSON-RPC request, managing request state, associated service, and request handling logic.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator
classes.description: Manages performance statistics for request processing, including deserialization, execution, and communication metrics.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Holds statistical data for request processing times and metrics.

classes.name: DataSet
classes.description: Stores individual timing measurements for different stages of request processing.

classes.name: Tuple
classes.description: Aggregates statistical measurements and provides methods for measurement and clearing data.

classes.name: TrackingJSONRPC
classes.description: Handles JSON-RPC request tracking, including timing and statistics collection.

methods.name: Set(uint32_t errorCode, const Core::ProxyType<PluginHost::Service>& service, const mode type)
methods.description: Sets the request's error code, associated service, and mode.

methods.name: RestfulCall()
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the RESTful prefix path.

methods.name: JSONRPCCall()
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the JSONRPC prefix path.

methods.name: State()
methods.description: Returns the current state of the request.

methods.name: Service()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated service proxy.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the request.

methods.name: In(uint32_t data)
methods.description: Records incoming data size and updates timing statistics.

methods.name: Out(uint32_t data)
methods.description: Records outgoing data size and updates timing statistics.

methods.name: Dispatch()
methods.description: Marks the dispatch time for the request.

methods.name: Acquire()
methods.description: Marks the start time for request processing.

methods.name: Relinquish()
methods.description: Marks the end time for request processing and stores statistics.
